text:
anna: Quick sync — putting together the changelog + whatsnew bullets for the docs deploy tomorrow. Need someone to sanity-check snippets and a short known-issues list.
marco: on it. which PRs are we including?
anna: main ones: #5301 (whatsnew draft), #5307 (embed examples), #5312 (sdk snippet fixes) and a small redirect patch #5315. Also call out streaming shape changes in known issues.
riley: i can take the curl + redirect sweep. found one staging link using /embed-old that should 301 to /embeddings.
jo: i'll update the python streaming sample — the client now yields event dicts instead of plain chunk objects. Proposed publishable snippet:```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
for ev in client.generate_stream(model='kestrel', prompt='Hey'):
    if ev.get('type') == 'token':
        print(ev.get('delta', ''), end='')
    elif ev.get('type') == 'done':
        print('\n-- stream finished --')
```
marco: add a one-line note above the snippet: "Streaming responses include token and control events (type: 'token'|'done')."
anna: known-issue draft: "Embeddings from quantized backends may differ slightly from float backends; test representative prompts before migrating." Keep it short.
riley: canonical curl snippet for whatsnew:```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"example text"}'
```
jo: note for docs: streaming may include control events like 'done' and 'warning' — add a tiny FAQ entry.
marco: i'll rewrite the whatsnew bullets as short bullets with CTAs. product asked for customer-facing language, light on jargon.
ci-bot: docs-lint | build 3421: passed 
anna: timeline: final copy by 4:30pm PT, freeze at 5:30pm, deploy in the evening window. flag any blockers here.
riley: running a grep for /embed vs /embeddings and opening redirects for matches now. found two stale anchors too.
jo: small phrasing nit: for embedding perf say "reduced latency for small inputs" instead of "improved tail latency". marketing prefers simpler phrasing.
marco: checklist: normalize curl params, update python streaming example, merge TS snippet, add known-issues block, run link sweep, consolidate whatsnew bullets. I'll post the final diff in this thread once merged.
anna: thanks — pinning to #docs for visibility. :thumbsup:
